title: Social Media Manager – Content & Digital Marketing
description:
\*\*Company:\*\* PropertyAngel Management Pvt. Ltd.

\*\*Location:\*\* Bangalore

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full\-time \| Permanent

\*\*Salary:\*\* ₹23,000 – ₹40,000 per month

About PropertyAngel

PropertyAngel is a Bangalore\-based PropTech company providing end\-to\-end property management services to residential property owners.

Established in \*\*2014\*\*, we currently manage over ₹2,500\+ crores of residential assets\*\*.

Our objective is simple — make owning and managing a property easier, safer, and more transparent.

The Role

We are looking for a \*\*creative, commercially aware, and data\-driven Marketing Executive\*\* who can take ownership of PropertyAngel's social media and contribute directly to the growth of the brand.

We want someone who can \*\*research what our audience cares about, identify content opportunities, create engaging content, grow our audience, generate organic leads, analyse what is working, and continuously find better ways to grow\*\*.

Social media and content, growth marketing, analytics, online reputation management, performance marketing, and SEO will be the primary focus of the role.

What You'll Be Responsible For

1\. Social Media, Content \& Organic Growth

\* Own and manage PropertyAngel's presence across \*\*Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms\*\*.

\* Research our target audience, competitors, real estate trends, customer questions, and trending topics to identify content opportunities.

\* Plan and maintain a structured \*\*social media content calendar\*\*.

\* Conceptualize, create, and publish \*\*reels, videos, posts, carousels, stories, and other engaging content\*\*.

\* Write compelling hooks, captions, scripts, and social media copy.

\* Create content around \*\*property ownership, rentals, property management, real estate, investment, and relevant trending topics\*\*.

\* Develop content designed to increase \*\*views, reach, engagement, followers, brand awareness, and organic enquiries\*\*.

\* Understand what makes content perform and continuously experiment with \*\*topics, hooks, formats, creatives, and distribution strategies\*\*.

\* Perform basic \*\*image and video editing\*\* and coordinate with external/internal creative resources when required.

2\. Growth Hacking \& Lead Generation

\* Constantly look for \*\*creative and cost\-effective ways to grow PropertyAngel's digital presence and generate leads\*\*.

\* Experiment with new content formats, platforms, collaborations, campaigns, communities, and distribution opportunities.

\* Convert successful experiments into repeatable growth initiatives.

\* Think beyond followers and views — understand how marketing activity can contribute to \*\*enquiries, qualified leads, and business growth\*\*.

3\. Analytics \& Sales Funnel

\* Track key metrics including \*\*reach, views, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, enquiries, leads, CPL, and conversions\*\*.

\* Analyse why certain content and campaigns perform better than others and use those insights to improve future activities.

\* Understand and track the journey from \*\*content → engagement → enquiry → lead → conversion\*\*.

\* Work with the sales team to understand \*\*lead quality and conversion performance\*\*.

\* Prepare simple, meaningful reports that highlight \*\*what worked, what didn't, why, and what should be done next\*\*.

4\. Brand \& Online Reputation

\* Monitor PropertyAngel's online presence across social media, reviews, comments, and other relevant platforms.

\* Respond to \*\*comments, messages, reviews, and online interactions\*\* in line with the company's communication standards.

\* Maintain a consistent brand voice across digital channels.

\* Identify potential reputation issues early and coordinate appropriate responses.

5\. Performance Marketing

\* Manage and monitor PropertyAngel's \*\*Meta and Google Ads campaigns\*\*.

\* Understand campaign objectives, audiences, creatives, budgets, and performance.

\* Track \*\*CPL, conversions, lead quality, spend, and ROI\*\*.

\* Review campaign performance and ensure campaigns are continuously being optimised towards business objectives.

\* Coordinate creatives, messaging, campaign requirements, and performance reviews.

6\. SEO \& Digital Marketing

\* Have a working understanding of \*\*SEO, keywords, search intent, and content optimisation\*\*.

\* Support website content, blogs, email marketing, and other digital initiatives when required.

\* Keep up with changes in \*\*social media, digital marketing, AI tools, content creation, and consumer behaviour\*\* and identify opportunities relevant to PropertyAngel.

Who We're Looking For

\* \*\*1–3 years of experience\*\* in social media, content marketing, digital marketing, or a similar role preferred.

\* Strong understanding of \*\*Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube\*\* and what makes content perform on each platform.

\* Someone who genuinely enjoys \*\*researching and creating content\*\*, not just publishing it.

\* Strong written communication and the ability to turn ideas into engaging \*\*hooks, captions, scripts, and posts\*\*.

\* A good balance of \*\*creativity and analytical thinking\*\*.

\* Strong \*\*business acumen\*\* — you should understand that marketing success is ultimately measured by its contribution to the business.

\* Comfortable working with \*\*social media analytics, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and Google Analytics\*\*.

\* Basic knowledge of \*\*SEO and image/video editing\*\*.

\* Familiarity with tools such as \*\*Canva and common video editing tools\*\*.

\* Curious, proactive, willing to experiment, and comfortable taking ownership of results.

What Success Looks Like

\* More relevant people are \*\*discovering PropertyAngel\*\*.

\* Our content is getting \*\*better reach, views, and engagement\*\*.

\* Our social media audience is \*\*growing consistently\*\*.

\* Content is generating \*\*organic enquiries and qualified leads\*\*.

\* Paid marketing is generating leads efficiently.

\* Our online reputation and communication remain strong.

\* Marketing is making a \*\*measurable contribution to business growth\*\*.

Why Join PropertyAngel?

You will have the opportunity to take genuine ownership of a growing brand's digital presence rather than simply execute instructions.

You'll be encouraged to \*\*research, experiment, create, analyse, and bring new ideas to the table\*\* — and you'll be able to see the direct impact of your work on both the brand and the business.

You'll work across \*\*social media, content, growth marketing, performance marketing, analytics, and PropTech\*\*, giving you the opportunity to develop into a well\-rounded digital marketer.

\*\*Benefits include:\*\*

\* Cell Phone Reimbursement

\* Health Insurance

\* Life Insurance

\* Provident Fund

Apply

Send us your resume along with examples or links to \*\*social media pages, reels, posts, campaigns, or other content you've worked on.\*\*

\*\*Come build PropertyAngel's next phase of digital growth with us.\*\*

Pay: ₹23,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Job Description – Manager: Life Sciences Commercial AI \& Data Analytics**

  


**Role Summary**



We are seeking a Manager in Life Sciences Commercial AI \& Data Analytics to lead client engagements that use pharmaceutical commercial, real\-world, and digital data to shape strategy and execution.



The role combines deep life sciences domain expertise with analytics leadership, client advisory, and practical knowledge of AI and modern data platforms. The Manager will frame complex business questions, design fit\-for\-purpose analytics and data solutions, guide multidisciplinary teams, and translate evidence into decisions across brand strategy, omnichannel engagement, customer analytics, launch, field effectiveness, and patient analytics.



The ideal candidate will be a credible commercial analytics advisor who can connect pharmaceutical market dynamics with data, technology, and delivery realities — ensuring that solutions are analytically sound, scalable, compliant, and useful to business stakeholders.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Lead Commercial Analytics Strategy and Delivery**
	+ Lead analytics engagements addressing market opportunity, patient journeys, segmentation and targeting, omnichannel performance, launch readiness, field effectiveness, forecasting, and brand performance.
	+ Frame ambiguous client challenges into clear hypotheses, analytical workplans, success measures, and decision points.
	+ Guide the selection and interpretation of pharmaceutical commercial and real\-world data, ensuring that populations, cohorts, business rules, metrics, and limitations are appropriate to the business question.
	+ Own delivery quality, timelines, risks, and executive\-ready outputs across multiple workstreams.
* **Shape AI and Advanced Analytics Solutions**
	+ Identify high\-value applications of machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics across commercial functions, and distinguish viable opportunities from technology\-led experimentation.
	+ Direct the design and validation of solutions such as segmentation, propensity, next\-best\-action, forecasting, anomaly detection, NLP, and AI\-assisted insight generation.
	+ Ensure responsible AI practices, including appropriate data use, transparency, human oversight, performance monitoring, documentation, and compliance with client and regulatory expectations.
	+ Explain model assumptions, limitations, and business trade\-offs to senior stakeholders in accessible language.
* **Provide Data and Solution Architecture Direction**
	+ Guide teams in designing scalable analytical datasets, reusable data models, and robust ETL/ELT pipelines across claims, EHR/EMR, laboratory, SP/HUB, CRM, sales, access, and digital sources.
	+ Set expectations for data quality, lineage, metadata, reproducibility, security, and documentation, and oversee resolution of complex data issues.
	+ Partner with data engineers, architects, data scientists, and visualization specialists to align solution design with analytical needs and enterprise technology standards.
	+ Promote reusable assets, modular code, automation, and cloud\-based delivery approaches that improve quality and speed across engagements.
* **Advise Clients and Translate Evidence into Action**
	+ Act as a trusted advisor to commercial, marketing, sales, market access, analytics, and technology stakeholders.
	+ Synthesize analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and implementation priorities.
	+ Lead workshops and senior stakeholder discussions, challenge assumptions constructively, and build alignment around decisions.
	+ Ensure recommendations reflect pharmaceutical market dynamics, treatment pathways, customer needs, regulatory constraints, and operational feasibility.
* **Lead Teams and Build the Practice**
	+ Lead, coach, and review multidisciplinary teams, creating clarity on roles, standards, timelines, and expected outcomes.
	+ Develop team capability across life sciences domain knowledge, analytics methods, AI, data engineering, quality assurance, and business storytelling.
	+ Contribute to proposals, solution design, thought leadership, reusable accelerators, and the development of EY offerings.
	+ Support account growth by identifying adjacent client needs and articulating differentiated, value\-led solutions.
  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


**Experience**


* 7–12 years of experience in life sciences commercial analytics, healthcare analytics, analytics consulting, data science, or a related field, including significant responsibility for client and team leadership.
* Deep experience with pharmaceutical datasets such as IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Optum, HealthVerity, TriNetX, EHR/EMR, claims, SP/HUB, laboratory, CRM, sales, market access, and digital engagement data.
* Strong understanding of the US pharmaceutical commercial model and familiarity with global markets, including commercial functions, patient and HCP journeys, therapeutic areas, launch dynamics, and regulatory and privacy considerations.
* Proven leadership across multiple commercial use cases such as patient analytics, segmentation, targeting, omnichannel measurement, marketing mix, field effectiveness, forecasting, launch analytics, or market assessment.
* Experience shaping and overseeing analytics solutions using SQL, Python/R, BI tools, and modern cloud data platforms; sufficient technical depth to review solution design and challenge delivery teams.
* Experience directing data integration and engineering work, including analytical data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, data\-quality controls, lineage, and reusable delivery assets.
* Experience designing or governing machine\-learning or generative\-AI solutions, including model validation, adoption, monitoring, and responsible AI considerations.
* Demonstrated experience managing senior client relationships, multidisciplinary teams, project economics, delivery risks, and competing priorities.

  


**Domain and Consulting Skills**


* Deep pharmaceutical commercial and healthcare domain expertise, with credibility in senior business discussions.
* Strategic, hypothesis\-driven problem solving and the ability to structure complex, ambiguous client challenges.
* Ability to connect commercial strategy, analytical methods, AI opportunities, data architecture, and implementation realities.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.
* High standards for analytical rigor, data quality, documentation, and delivery governance.
* Inclusive people leadership, coaching, and performance\-management capability across diverse and distributed teams.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to identify client value, shape proposals, and expand relationships.

  


**Educational Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in life sciences, engineering, data science, business, or a related discipline.
* An MBA or advanced degree in pharma, healthcare, analytics, or a related field is preferred.

  


**Preferred (Good\-to\-Have)**


* Experience supporting US or global pharmaceutical commercial teams.
* Experience in oncology or another complex specialty therapeutic area.
* Experience contributing to consulting proposals, reusable accelerators, or analytics products.

  


**What we look for**



We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to accomplish them. We value an entrepreneurial spirit: people who are innovative by nature and continually explore better approaches, products, services, and technologies.



Helping clients solve complex problems and implement practical solutions requires intellectual rigor, commercial judgment, curiosity, and a clear understanding of what works in real delivery environments. We seek people who lead themselves and others effectively, foster inclusive teamwork, and consistently deliver high\-quality outcomes.

  


**What working at EY offers**



At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You will work on inspiring and meaningful projects, supported by education, coaching, and practical experience that enables your continued development.



You will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality, knowledge exchange, and opportunities to build new skills and progress your career.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Key Account Manager - Dispensing
description:
Life is too short for a boring career, so build an extraordinary one with us. We believe your career should spark the same thrill and curiosity as your personal interests. Creativity drives everything we do, turning ideas into meaningful impact. With opportunities across brands, markets, and divisions, your growth knows no boundaries. Read on to know more about what’s in store for you!
  
  

**Job Title:** Regional Dispensing Channel Manager \- L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty Division (Mumbai, India)
  
  

Hello, we’re L’Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it). Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.
  
  

A Day in the Life Reporting to the Regional Sales Manager, L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty and the National Dispensing and Medical Visits Manager, you will be responsible for the following Key Deliverables:
  
  

* Channel Strategy \& Business Development:
* Analyze market opportunities, potential, and gaps within the dispensing channel across the South and West regions.
* Analyse prescription potential of targets and the competitive, medical and regulatory environment.
* Drive RCPA (Retail Chemist Prescription Audit) compliance and execution across key pharmacies in the region.
* Define targets, their coverage and visit frequency.
* Develop and execute strategic Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with key dispensing clinics to drive sell\-out and achieve regional sales targets.
* Devise action plans, budgets, giveaways (promotional items and samples) and validate medical visit tools, for each target, in conjunction with marketing / and staff in charge of medical communication.
* Portfolio Promotion \& Negotiation: Present and negotiate commercial agreements, product bundles, and promotional strategies.
* Pilot performance based on criteria of prescriptions/recommendations and sales and analyse Return On Investment (ROI).
* Key Opinion Leader (KOL) \& Commercial Account Management:


o Maintain strong personal connections and strategic relationships with top dermatologists and key dispensing stakeholders in the region.
  
  

o Build and nurture strong commercial relationships with key decision\-makers, dermatologists, and clinic administrators within dispensing accounts in his/her region.
  
  

o Lead regional derm activation, engagement, and Advocacy agendas.
  
  

* Team Support \& Performance Enablement:


o Support Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Medical Representative teams in executing dispensing strategies.
  
  

o Monitor and review MR team performance, field effectiveness, and target achievement within the dispensing channel.
  
  

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration:


o Liaison closely with the Medical Training and Communication teams to ensure seamless execution of medical detailing tools and training modules.
  
  

o Collaborate with regional sales and marketing teams to ensure synergy between commercial targets and medical/dispensing initiatives.
  
  

* Guarantee the excellence and professionalization of medical detailing:


o Makes sure field team has required digital tools and competences to engage with HCPs through all relevant channels (digital and face\-to\-face).
  
  

o Implement and guarantee the use of monitoring tools of CRM/CLM platform activity.
  
  

* Ethical Standards:


o Ensure training and respect of both internal and external ethical standards regarding relations with health professionals.
  
  

* Market Intelligence:


o Monitor account performance, track key commercial metrics, and maintain sharp awareness of competitor activities within the dermatology space.
  
  

We Are Looking For
  
  

To succeed in this role, you should possess the following attributes:
  
  

**Key Competencies:**  

* Strong understanding of the dermatological and dispensing retail ecosystem.
* Excellent relationship\-building and stakeholder management skills with top HCPs/Dermatologists.
* High commercial acumen with experience in sales, key account management, or medical detailing leadership. Strong negotiation and business planning skills with a proven track record of driving revenue growth in clinic/dispensing environments.
* Ability to coach, influence, and drive performance across cross\-functional field teams.


Qualifications \& Experience
  
* Education: MBA, Bachelor’s degree, B. Pharma/Life sciences
* Work Experience: Minimum 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, dermocosmetic, or medical sales, with exposure to key account management or field team leadership.


What’s In It For You
  
* A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
* Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal
* An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated
* A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference


**WHO WE ARE:**  

For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  

With our broad portfolio of 37 international brands and ambitious sustainability commitments in our L’Oréal for the Future program, we offer every person around the world the best in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity and responsibility, while celebrating beauty in its infinite plurality.
  
  

Present in India since 1994, L'Oréal India is a 100% subsidiary of L'Oréal S.A. Today, L'Oréal India is present on all distribution channels with 27 brands, available in consumer channels (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, NYX Professional Makeup); in hair and beauty salons (L'Oréal Professionnel, Matrix, Kérastase, Redken); in selective distribution (Kiehl's, Lancôme, Yves Saint Laurent), CeraVe and La Roche\-Posay in pharmacies and drugstores, and perfumes and make\-up sold through L'Oréal International Distribution (Armani, Prada, Valentino, Ralph Lauren, Diesel, Victor \& Rolf, Mugler, Azzaro, Maison Margiela, Cacharel, Guy Laroche, Urban Decay, Paloma Picasso, Youth To The People).
  
  

L'Oréal India employs more than 1,800 people in its head office in Mumbai, four regional offices, two production plants in Chakan (Maharashtra) and Baddi (Himachal Pradesh), two Research and Innovation centers in Mumbai (Maharashtra) and Bengaluru (Karnataka) and one India Technology Hub in Hyderabad.
  
  

In India, L'Oréal's Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives are built around three pillars: empowerment, environment and education. In addition to the group's CSR commitments, L'Oréal's brands (L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Maybelline New York, Kérastase, Matrix, L'Oréal Professionnel) are also leading community impact initiatives in India.
  
  

L’Oréal is committed to building a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. L’Oréal closely prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of the individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Architect,Salesforce
description:
Overview:
**About the company**


Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory \& transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost\-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise.

* Job Title: Salesforce Architect
* Location: Bangalore, India
* Employment Type: Full\-Time Experience
* Level: 10\+ years
* Benefits: Free pick \& drop,free meals,wifi reimbursements and more
* Shift: 2PM to 11 PM

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Salesforce Architect to join our team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Salesforce platform architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the broader Salesforce ecosystem. This role will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions by maximizing Salesforce out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities and strategically leveraging AppExchange solutions and third\-party plugins to meet business requirements. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, guiding platform strategy, governance, solution architecture, and enterprise\-wide Salesforce adoption.


Responsibilities:

Own and define the Salesforce architecture roadmap, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology and business strategies.  

  

Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce OOTB features and capabilities, including Flows, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, OmniStudio, Einstein AI, and Platform functionality before considering custom development.  

  

Evaluate, recommend, and implement Salesforce AppExchange applications, managed packages, and third\-party plugins to maximize business value while minimizing technical debt.  

  

Lead architecture and design sessions for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and future Salesforce platform initiatives.  

  

Establish enterprise integration patterns and oversee integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST APIs, middleware solutions, and event\-driven architectures.  

  

Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Developers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.  

  

Provide architectural leadership, governance, and mentorship to Salesforce Administrators, Developers, and Technical Leads.  

  

Drive platform optimization, security, data architecture, compliance, scalability, and performance best practices.  

  

Review and approve solution designs, ensuring adherence to Salesforce best practices, architectural standards, and long\-term maintainability.  

  

Support release management, environment strategy, and deployment governance in collaboration with DevOps and delivery teams.  

  

Ability to reverse engineer existing platform design and make recommendations to align with SalesForce OOTB best practices and configurations. **Requirements**  

10\+ years of progressive Salesforce experience, including significant experience in solution and platform architecture roles.  

  

Deep expertise across Salesforce platform capabilities, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Salesforce Platform.  

  

Proven experience designing and implementing solutions that maximize Salesforce OOTB functionality and reduce unnecessary customization.  

  

Strong experience evaluating, selecting, and implementing AppExchange applications, managed packages, and third\-party Salesforce ecosystem solutions.  

  

Expert understanding of Salesforce security architecture, sharing models, role hierarchies, permission sets, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements.  

  

Extensive experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs, middleware platforms, and integration best practices.  

  

Strong knowledge of Salesforce data architecture, master data management, large data volumes, and platform performance optimization.  

  

Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) sufficient to guide technical design decisions and development teams.  

  

Experience leading technical teams and collaborating with executive stakeholders in Agile/Scrum environments.  

  

Experience in Github, JIRA, Confluence, and CI/CD tools such as Gearset.  

  

Salesforce Application Architect and/or Salesforce System Architect certifications required.  

  

Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification is highly preferred.
Qualifications:

Experience leading enterprise\-wide Salesforce transformation initiatives and multi\-cloud implementations.  

  

Knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and AI\-powered Salesforce capabilities.  

  

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, and technology roadmaps.  

  

Experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or similar technologies.  

  

Experience supporting global Salesforce organizations with complex business processes and large user communities. **Why Join Us:**

* **Be part of a collaborative and innovative work environment.**
* **Opportunity for professional growth and development.**
* **Competitive salary and benefits package.**
* **Contribute to shaping the future of our software development processes.**

 **Consilio’s True North Values**

* **Client Experience** \| Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
* **Collaboration** \| Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
* **Innovation** \| Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
* **Grit** \| Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

  

Consilio, LLC is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

description:

:
**Job Summary**
---------------

As a Relationship Manager, you will build trusted relationships with Priority Banking and Priority Private Banking clients, helping them achieve their wealth goals through tailored investment and portfolio solutions. Supported by specialists in investment, insurance, products, and treasury, you’ll deliver comprehensive strategies that drive long\-term growth and stability.
  

  

This role gives you the opportunity to demonstrate your expertise in relationship management, sales, and client engagement, while advancing your career across Wealth and Retail Banking or other client segments.


**About our Wealth and Retail Banking business**  

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.
  

  

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross\-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
  

  

We’re investing USD $1\.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

• Support our clients in achieving their financial goals as they progress through their career and life\-stages.
  

• Build long\-term relationships by understanding clients’ financial needs and aspirations and delivering tailored wealth and investment solutions.
  

• Share timely market insights and investment updates from the Chief Investment Office (CIO) to help clients make informed decisions.
  

• Leverage digital tools such as myWealth to create customised portfolios and monitor performance based on CIO guidance.
  

• Deliver exceptional client experiences through proactive engagement and personalised service.


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

• Relevant experience with a minimum of two years in client acquisition, relationship management, and retail banking.
  

• Technical expertise in consumer banking products, including treasury, equities, funds, and insurance.
  

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  

• Proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented, international environment.
  

• Local market knowledge with established client networks and understanding of regional dynamics.


**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.


Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.


Together we:


* **Do the right thing** and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* **Never settle,** continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* **Are better together** , we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
**What we offer**
-----------------

**In line with our Fair Pay Charter** , we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.


* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** , with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time\-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* **Flexible working** options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* **Proactive wellbeing support** through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** , one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Account Development Representative
description:
**Location**
------------


Bangalore, India


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


On\-site


**Department**
--------------


All Cost CenterSalesSales Development


  
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**


If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box \- we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.


The is a hybrid role is based in Bangalore.


**About the Role:**


At Kong, our Sales Development team works closely with our partners in both Sales and Marketing to build fanatical customer enthusiasm around Kong. Sales Development reps are responsible for identifying and qualifying new opportunities for our sales organization. We view our Sales Development program as the best way to turbocharge a long and successful career in sales and view our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) as the next wave of Account Executives at Kong.


To aid in this endeavor, we invest heavily in the training and development of our team. This includes a 2\-week long sales bootcamp, weekly 1\-1 mentorship, and global virtual group trainings. By joining our team, you are making an investment in yourself that will accelerate the rest of your sales career.


Our SDRs gain an understanding of our product, community, who we sell to, why they care, and what makes us relevant. They learn how to generate a pipeline quickly and effectively as well as how to achieve a good discovery and qualification. The team is a crucial resource for sales teams across Kong to get great talent from. This helps us scale our teams, as well as ensure that we have a culture of meritocracy.


Being an SDR, is often a first step to jump\-starting a career in sales. At Kong, we have a culture that celebrates diversity, fosters growth and enablement, and ensures that we provide our SDRs with the tools and the confidence that they need to grow their careers.


The SDR leadership team has a true understanding of where each SDR is at in their personal development process, and mentors and enables them to ensure that they have the means and opportunity to be considered for their next role. At Kong, we truly believe that if you want to earn your MBA in sales, this is the place to be. As a leadership team, we spend an exorbitant amount of time working in the trenches with our teams to help them fine hone their business and sales acumen and ramp them to productivity, success, and greater roles.

  

**What You'll Do:**


**Market Opportunity** \- We are on a quest to build a $10b\+ software company over the next few years and need YOUR help!


Why APIs Matter? APIs have been enabling innovation for decades!


Strong VC team, Series D, strong year over year revenue growth!


**Technical Leadership** \- We are recognized as the leader in innovation in the connectivity space.


Marco, our CTO/co\-founder \- “We are the Cisco of L4 and L7” \- CUBE Conversation, March 2021


We are the leading innovator in the connectivity space!


**Amazing Team \& Culture** \- Come be a "Konger" and find out what we mean.


Great Place to Work Certified in 2020 \& 2021


Kong employees exemplify our culture at our 2022 Sales Kickoff


2022 Forbes Cloud 100 Honoree


**Building Great Products** \- Learn why the world's largest companies love our tech!


Kong Named a Leader in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant


Over 250m\+ downloads of our open source API gateway! Over 40k\+ stars on Github between Kong API and Kong Insomnia!


**What you'll be doing: Your First 90 Days**


* **By the end of month 1, you will:**
* Have met your new team and had fun playing with some new tools
* Become a part of the wider Kong family
* Have had a successful sales boot camp training
* Have a good understanding of what makes Kong’s product offerings so special
* Understand how our Sales Development, Marketing and Account Executive teams all work together
* **By the end of month 2, you will:**
* Be comfortable talking to clients on the phone about Kong
* Have worked with our Account Executive team on your first opportunity
* Have shadowed a ton of calls and practiced several role\-plays
* Started delivering your ramp quota
* **By the end of month 3, you will:**
* Know our sales funnel inside and out, and feel confident to add value to our sales org
* Show clear delivery of our sales methodologies
* Provide insights to both our Sales Development and marketing organizations to help us continue to iterate and improve
* Delivered against your ramp quota
* **Role Overview \& Key Responsibilities:**
* Work with the Sales team to develop inbound and outbound campaigns from idea generation through to qualified call
* Develop strong sales and product knowledge.
* Interact with IT and business decision\-makers via telephone, video, LinkedIn, and email
* Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management
* Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team
* Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential
* Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota
* Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business.
* Invest in your self\-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success
* And any additional tasks required by the manager.

**What You'll Bring:**


* 1 year or more of strong sales or customer\-facing experience.
* A self\-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals.
* A ‘hunter’ mentality \- comfortable prospecting, cold\-calling, and following up on incoming leads and a strong desire to win.
* Ability and willingness to learn, react to and share lessons learned across the organisation.
* Open to feedback and can apply to your daily workflow.
* Outstanding communication skills including both phone and written communication as well as active listening.
* An extraordinary character with an incredible drive for success, a high work ethic, curious by nature, and obsessed with smashing sales goals.
* Validated time leadership skills and ability to work independently and through coaching.
* Desire to work in a driven and fast\-paced environment.

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
Job Description
**Manager Strategy \& Operations**
**Clear’s Vision**
==================


Clear makes software for the CFO's office. We started with tax compliance in India and now sell in 11 countries. Governments around the world are introducing rules that require businesses to report their invoices to the tax authority and exchange them over government\-designated networks. 29 countries have mandates coming into force between now and 2030\. Each mandate means enterprises have to change how their finance systems work, usually against a fixed deadline, and they need a vendor to do it for them.  

  

**Where we are as of today:**  

* 3,700\+ enterprise customers
  
* Live or ready in 11 countries, up from 3 a year ago. We expect 25\+ by early 2027\.
  
* Government accreditation in India, Saudi Arabia, UAE, France and Oman
  
* 6M\+ invoices processed a week in Saudi Arabia alone, at 99\.9% success
  
* Targeting profitable growth with 40%\+ revenue CAGR over the next three years
  


Our international business will be larger than our India business within the year. We have also started working in markets well ahead of their mandate dates, currently the Philippines and Spain.
Alongside the compliance business we have begun building AI products on top of the finance data we already hold for customers. CFO Studio and Agent Studio let finance teams build agents that do actual work rather than produce reports.
This is the bigger opportunity for us over the next few years. We already hold compliance data for a few thousand enterprises, which puts us in a reasonable position to take on more of the work that runs a CFO's office.
**Purpose of the Role**
=======================


This role sits in the CEO's office and reports to the Chief of Staff to the CEO.  

  

**What you will be responsible for**
**Running programmes through to a decision.** You will be given something loosely defined — that we take too long to open a new market, or that our win rate in Europe is not improving. You work out what the goal should be, who needs to be involved and what the plan is, then run it until a decision is made and implemented.
**Operating cadence and reporting.** Weekly and monthly reviews across markets and business lines, with one set of numbers that everyone works off. A large part of this is noticing when something is going wrong early enough that it can still be acted on, rather than reporting it once the quarter has closed.
**New market work.** For countries whose mandates are 18 to 24 months away, we need to understand the size of the opportunity, the partner and regulatory landscape, and what has to be ready and by when. You would be doing this research yourself.
**Analysis on open questions.** Pricing, partnership models, cross\-sell, where the next increment of GTM budget should go. We would want a recommendation you have thought through and can argue for, rather than a summary of what other people think.  

  

**Role Scope**
The scope is to cover any kind of programs pertaining to Strategy and Operations. The list of programs is not constant and keeps evolving as new problems are uncovered or changing priorities. To give examples of a few programs are \-  

* **Business strategy \-** Going through the historical patterns and identifying strategic levers \& initiatives to grow sales
  
* **Rhythms and rituals \-** These would include business review rhythms, pipeline reviews, interlocks with other non\-sales functions, etc.
  
* **Customer segmentation \-** Segment customers into logical cohorts and orient sales/ sdr/ marketing towards high value cohorts.
  
* **KPI planning \-** Defining the right KPIs for the sales / sdr teams \- output and inputs
  
* **Sales enablement \-** Defining the training needs based on wins/ losses and running a structured program to upgrade the wider sales team
  
* **Process streamlining and automation \-** Critically evaluating the as\-is process of sales (external as well as internal) and implement tools for automation to drive productivity
  


**Competencies Required**  

* Analytical Acumen \- Ability to drive meaning out of numbers. This has multiple components:
	+ Data accuracy \- ensuring data is always accurate and reliable
	+ Insights \- leveraging data to generate insights for the leaders
	+ Actions \- leveraging insights to recommend high impact actions.
  
* Strategic Thinking \- Ability to take step\-back from regular operations work and think long\-term for the business. This implies \- Building independent point of views on strategic decisions \- such as partnership or cross\-sell motion, etc.
  
* Program Management \- ability to manage multiple programs via impact\-based prioritisation and keep relevant stakeholders always informed. This also includes forecasting risk (pre\-morterm) and taking corrective actions.
  
* Process, Playbook \& Technology first Mindset \- ability to think of processes in the form of scalable playbooks which can be implemented and sales can be enabled on. This also means having a technology and AI first first mindset to maximise automation vs manual work.
  
* Sales Acumen \- Ability to understand how B2B sales motion works, what are the deal success factors, what are the top metrics tracked, how sales folks behave, etc.
  


**Qualification Pre\-Requisite**  

* Proven 1\-3 years of experience for the Program Manager role

  

* Should have worked in a technology startup before or premier Consulting firm with projects in the technology/ software industry
  
* Exposure to B2B Sales is preferable but not mandatory

description:
Marketing Executive – Social Media \& Growth Marketing

Company: PropertyAngel Management Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Bangalore

Employment Type: Full\-time \| Permanent

Salary: ₹23,000 – ₹40,000 per month

About PropertyAngel

PropertyAngel is a Bangalore\-based PropTech company providing end\-to\-end property management services to residential property owners.

Established in \*\*2014\*\*, we currently manage over ₹2,500\+ crores of residential assets\*\*.

Our objective is simple — make owning and managing a property easier, safer, and more transparent.

The Role

We are looking for a \*\*creative, commercially aware, and data\-driven Marketing Executive\*\* who can take ownership of PropertyAngel's social media and contribute directly to the growth of the brand.

This is not a role limited to posting content.

We want someone who can \*\*research what our audience cares about, identify content opportunities, create engaging content, grow our audience, generate organic leads, analyse what is working, and continuously find better ways to grow\*\*.

Social media and content will be the primary focus of the role, supported by \*\*growth marketing, analytics, online reputation management, performance marketing, and SEO\*\*.

What You'll Be Responsible For

1\. Social Media, Content \& Organic Growth

\* Own and manage PropertyAngel's presence across \*\*Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms\*\*.

\* Research our target audience, competitors, real estate trends, customer questions, and trending topics to identify content opportunities.

\* Plan and maintain a structured \*\*social media content calendar\*\*.

\* Conceptualize, create, and publish \*\*reels, videos, posts, carousels, stories, and other engaging content\*\*.

\* Write compelling hooks, captions, scripts, and social media copy.

\* Create content around \*\*property ownership, rentals, property management, real estate, investment, and relevant trending topics\*\*.

\* Develop content designed to increase \*\*views, reach, engagement, followers, brand awareness, and organic enquiries\*\*.

\* Understand what makes content perform and continuously experiment with \*\*topics, hooks, formats, creatives, and distribution strategies\*\*.

\* Perform basic \*\*image and video editing\*\* and coordinate with external/internal creative resources when required.

2\. Growth Hacking \& Lead Generation

\* Constantly look for \*\*creative and cost\-effective ways to grow PropertyAngel's digital presence and generate leads\*\*.

\* Experiment with new content formats, platforms, collaborations, campaigns, communities, and distribution opportunities.

\* Convert successful experiments into repeatable growth initiatives.

\* Think beyond followers and views — understand how marketing activity can contribute to \*\*enquiries, qualified leads, and business growth\*\*.

3\. Analytics \& Sales Funnel

\* Track key metrics including \*\*reach, views, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, enquiries, leads, CPL, and conversions\*\*.

\* Analyse why certain content and campaigns perform better than others and use those insights to improve future activities.

\* Understand and track the journey from \*\*content → engagement → enquiry → lead → conversion\*\*.

\* Work with the sales team to understand \*\*lead quality and conversion performance\*\*.

\* Prepare simple, meaningful reports that highlight \*\*what worked, what didn't, why, and what should be done next\*\*.

4\. Brand \& Online Reputation

\* Monitor PropertyAngel's online presence across social media, reviews, comments, and other relevant platforms.

\* Respond to \*\*comments, messages, reviews, and online interactions\*\* in line with the company's communication standards.

\* Maintain a consistent brand voice across digital channels.

\* Identify potential reputation issues early and coordinate appropriate responses.

5\. Performance Marketing

\* Manage and monitor PropertyAngel's \*\*Meta and Google Ads campaigns\*\*.

\* Understand campaign objectives, audiences, creatives, budgets, and performance.

\* Track \*\*CPL, conversions, lead quality, spend, and ROI\*\*.

\* Review campaign performance and ensure campaigns are continuously being optimised towards business objectives.

\* Coordinate creatives, messaging, campaign requirements, and performance reviews.

6\. SEO \& Digital Marketing

\* Have a working understanding of \*\*SEO, keywords, search intent, and content optimisation\*\*.

\* Support website content, blogs, email marketing, and other digital initiatives when required.

\* Keep up with changes in \*\*social media, digital marketing, AI tools, content creation, and consumer behaviour\*\* and identify opportunities relevant to PropertyAngel.

Who We're Looking For

\* \*\*1–3 years of experience\*\* in social media, content marketing, digital marketing, or a similar role preferred.

\* Strong understanding of \*\*Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube\*\* and what makes content perform on each platform.

\* Someone who genuinely enjoys \*\*researching and creating content\*\*, not just publishing it.

\* Strong written communication and the ability to turn ideas into engaging \*\*hooks, captions, scripts, and posts\*\*.

\* A good balance of \*\*creativity and analytical thinking\*\*.

\* Strong \*\*business acumen\*\* — you should understand that marketing success is ultimately measured by its contribution to the business.

\* Comfortable working with \*\*social media analytics, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and Google Analytics\*\*.

\* Basic knowledge of \*\*SEO and image/video editing\*\*.

\* Familiarity with tools such as \*\*Canva and common video editing tools\*\*.

\* Curious, proactive, willing to experiment, and comfortable taking ownership of results.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn't measured by how many posts you publish.

It's measured by whether:

\* More relevant people are \*\*discovering PropertyAngel\*\*.

\* Our content is getting \*\*better reach, views, and engagement\*\*.

\* Our social media audience is \*\*growing consistently\*\*.

\* Content is generating \*\*organic enquiries and qualified leads\*\*.

\* Paid marketing is generating leads efficiently.

\* Our online reputation and communication remain strong.

\* Marketing is making a \*\*measurable contribution to business growth\*\*.

Why Join PropertyAngel?

You will have the opportunity to take genuine ownership of a growing brand's digital presence rather than simply execute instructions.

You'll be encouraged to \*\*research, experiment, create, analyse, and bring new ideas to the table\*\* — and you'll be able to see the direct impact of your work on both the brand and the business.

You'll work across \*\*social media, content, growth marketing, performance marketing, analytics, and PropTech\*\*, giving you the opportunity to develop into a well\-rounded digital marketer.

\*\*Benefits include:\*\*

\* Cell Phone Reimbursement

\* Health Insurance

\* Life Insurance

\* Provident Fund

Apply

Send us your resume along with examples or links to \*\*social media pages, reels, posts, campaigns, or other content you've worked on.\*\*

\*\*Come build PropertyAngel's next phase of digital growth with us.\*\*

title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst - India
description:
**Location**
------------


Bangalore, India

-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**

On\-site

--------------


All Cost CenterSalesRevenue Operations


  
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**


If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box \- we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.


**About the Role:**


Kong's Marketing Operations team is the operational backbone of the go\-to\-market engine. This role is built around execution, but it doesn't stop there. You'll own the day\-to\-day intake queue, turning marketer requests into clean, accurate, on\-time programs in Marketo. And you'll bring enough curiosity and systems thinking to spot what's inefficient, broken, or worth automating, and say something about it.


You'll work closely with a globally distributed team supporting the systems, processes, and data infrastructure that connect marketing activity to pipeline.

  

**What You'll Do:**


* Build, QA, and send emails in Marketo from intake requests: template setup, token population, smart list configuration, scheduling, and send confirmation
* Process list imports end\-to\-end: field normalization, deduplication checks, schema mapping, and load validation against Salesforce
* Build audience segments and smart lists for campaign targeting based on marketer\-provided criteria; validate logic before use and flag coverage gaps
* Maintain lead flow integrity for records touching your work: lifecycle stage accuracy, routing correctness, and Marketo\-SFDC sync health
* Handle operational workflows including suppression list updates, unsubscribe management, and compliance record corrections
* Identify recurring patterns in the intake queue and propose process improvements or automation before someone has to ask twice
* Document execution workflows and build repeatable checklists so output quality stays consistent at volume
* Stay current on marketing automation capabilities and adjacent GTM tooling; bring ideas back and pressure\-test them against real use cases

**What You'll Bring:**


* 4\-6\+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or a GTM systems role
* Strong hands\-on Marketo experience: email execution, smart lists, tokens, program architecture, and troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of Salesforce: enough to validate sync behavior, catch attribution gaps, and escalate when something doesn't land correctly
* Comfort with data: list hygiene, field normalization, deduplication logic, and compliance requirements (GDPR, CAN\-SPAM)
* A process improvement instinct: you see how something works and immediately think about how it could work better
* High accuracy and attention to detail; you QA your own work before it goes live and own the fix when it doesn't
* Ability to manage a queue of concurrent requests, prioritize effectively, and communicate proactively when something is blocked
* Comfortable working autonomously and asynchronously with a globally distributed team

**Nice to have:**


* Experience with HTML email editing
* Hands\-on experience with GTM orchestration or workflow automation tools such as Clay, Zapier, or similar
* Familiarity with data platforms like Snowflake or BI tools like Tableau
* Exposure to lead scoring models and attribution methodology
* Background in B2B SaaS or a technical product environment

**What we're looking for beyond the resume:**


Someone who takes pride in execution quality and doesn't let a request go out the door with a broken link or the wrong segment. Who also notices when the same type of request comes in for the tenth time and asks whether it should be automated instead. The work is high\-volume and detail\-intensive, and the best person in this role will do it well while quietly making it easier for everyone around them.


\#LI\-SP1


**About Kong:**


Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI\-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.
