title: Senior Manager- Industrial Assets
description:
Job Title: Senior Manager\- Industrial Assets
City: Bengaluru
State/Province: Karnataka
Posting Start Date: 9/23/26
Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.


**About the Role:**

Wipro Consulting is seeking a **Partner with deep domain expertise in the Chemicals industry** to drive growth, client impact, and digital transformation engagements for the US Markets. This leader will bring strong subject matter knowledge across chemical manufacturing, operations, and supply chain, while leveraging digital technologies—including **AI, data, and advanced analytics** —to solve complex business problems for global clients.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead client engagements focused on **manufacturing excellence, new product innovation, process optimization, sustainability, and regulatory compliance** .


* Design and implement **AI/ML\-enabled solutions** for predictive maintenance, pricing optimization, digital R\&D, demand forecasting, safety, and ESG reporting.


* Partner with cross\-functional teams to develop and deliver **end\-to\-end digital transformation programs** .


* Build and nurture relationships with **industry bodies, technology partners, and thought leaders** to advance Wipro’s chemicals practice.


* Mentor and grow consulting teams with deep domain and digital capabilities.


* Research, distill and present value propositions for customers including assembling marketing collateral and targeted campaigns.


**Qualifications:**

* **Master’s or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related discipline** (strong preference).


* 18\+ years of experience in the **Chemicals industry** and/or consulting with proven impact in manufacturing, R\&D, or commercial operations.


* Strong understanding of **chemical processes, specialty vs. commodity segments, and industry trends** (e.g., sustainability, digital plants, digital R\&D).


* Demonstrated track record of **delivering digital and AI\-enabled transformation initiatives** in chemicals or process industries.


* Experience or training in continuous improvement programs (Six Sigma, LEAN, etc) is preferred.


* Excellent client\-facing, leadership, and communication skills.
  

Wipro Consulting is seeking a Senior Manager with deep domain expertise in Industrial Assets to join the Energy, Manufacturing \& Resources (EMR) practice. In this role, you will serve as a trusted C\-suite advisor to leading energy and industrial clients, shaping the strategic agenda for asset\-intensive operations — spanning asset integrity management, reliability engineering, maintenance optimization, and the digital and operating\-model transformation of the asset base. You will translate enterprise strategy into executable transformation roadmaps that unlock measurable value across throughput, cost, capital efficiency, and reliability.


You will lead cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-impact, value\-led engagements for global clients across the oil and gas, petrochemicals, and industrial sectors. The ideal candidate combines strong consulting and commercial acumen with hands\-on experience in industrial asset management, leveraging AI, GenAI, IoT, and advanced analytics to reinvent how clients operate and extract value from their assets — from opportunity identification through execution and scale.


**͏**
-----


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Consulting \& Client Engagement**

* Lead strategic consulting engagements that reshape industrial asset management, asset integrity, reliability, and maintenance strategy — defining value\-led transformation scenarios across asset strategy, operating model, and digital capabilities for energy and industrial clients.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (VP and C\-suite level), framing the strategic agenda and delivering recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes across value, EBITDA, and capital efficiency.
* Develop and present compelling proposals, Points of View (PoVs), and value\-led solution frameworks that shape client demand, originate pipeline, and win new engagements.
* Build and deepen long\-term, C\-suite\-level relationships with major energy companies, driving pipeline origination, repeat business, and sustained account growth.

**Domain Expertise \& Solution Delivery**

* Bring deep subject matter expertise in one or more of the following areas:
	+ Asset Integrity Management (AIM) and Risk\-Based Inspection (RBI)
	+ Reliability\-Centered Maintenance (RCM) and Predictive Maintenance strategies
	+ Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) systems such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or Oracle EAM
	+ Corrosion management, mechanical integrity, and fitness\-for\-service assessments
	+ Capital project advisory and turnaround planning for industrial facilities
* Design and implement Target Operating Models (TOMs) for asset management functions — underpinned by clear value trees and decision frameworks — ensuring alignment with industry standards (ISO 55000, API, ASME).
* Lead digital transformation initiatives — defining the digital North Star and roadmap and leveraging IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, digital twins, and advanced analytics to optimize asset lifecycle performance and value.

**Delivery Excellence \& Project Leadership**

* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of consulting engagements with disciplined margin and P\&L control, ensuring on\-time, on\-budget, and high\-quality outcomes.
* Oversee project governance, risk mitigation, and executive stakeholder communication across multi\-shore delivery teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery, leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, and a Management Operating System (MOS) to embed performance management and accountability.

**Thought Leadership \& Practice Building**

* Drive the growth of the EMR Industrial Assets consulting practice through solution development, capability building, market positioning, and pipeline origination.
* Develop and publish whitepapers, case studies, and industry insights on industrial asset management trends and digital innovation.
* Represent Wipro Consulting at industry forums, conferences, and analyst briefings.
* Mentor, develop, and scale consulting talent, fostering a culture of domain excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.
**͏**
-----


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 12–18 years of overall experience, with at least 5–7 years in consulting or advisory roles focused on industrial assets and asset\-intensive transformation within the energy, oil and gas, or process industries.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Petroleum, or related discipline). MBA or Master’s degree is preferred.
* Proven track record of leading and delivering strategic consulting engagements in asset integrity, reliability engineering, maintenance and operating\-model transformation, or industrial operations.
* Strong understanding of asset\-intensive industries, including upstream, midstream, and downstream oil and gas operations.
* Experience with Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) platforms such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or Oracle EAM.
* Familiarity with industry standards and regulatory frameworks (ISO 55000, API 580/581, ASME, OSHA PSM).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-million\-dollar consulting portfolios, pipeline, and client P\&L responsibilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience working with major energy companies (IOCs, NOCs, or large independent operators).
* Certifications such as Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE), Certified Maintenance \& Reliability Professional (CMRP), or ISO 55001 Lead Auditor.
* Hands\-on experience with digital technologies for industrial assets, including IoT sensors, predictive and advanced analytics, digital twins, GenAI, and AI\-driven decision support systems.
* Experience in continuous improvement and operating\-model transformation methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma Black Belt).
* Track record of contributing to thought leadership through published articles, conference presentations, or industry body participation.
* Strong global exposure, with experience originating and managing engagements across multiple geographies and go\-to\-market regions.

**WHY WIPRO CONSULTING?**

* Be part of a rapidly growing global consulting practice serving Fortune 500 energy and industrial clients.
* Work on transformative engagements that combine deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge digital technologies.
* Collaborate with a diverse, global team of industry experts, technologists, and business strategists.
* Access world\-class learning and development programs to accelerate your career growth.
* Contribute to Wipro’s mission of delivering sustainable, responsible business transformation for clients worldwide.
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.


Wipro is committed to creating an accessible, supportive, and inclusive workplace. Reasonable accommodation will be provided to all applicants including persons with disabilities, throughout the recruitment and selection process. Accommodations must be communicated in advance of the application, where possible, and will be reviewed on an individual basis. Wipro provides equal opportunities to all and values diversity.

title: CEO
description:
CEO — MOONBLISS (FEMALES ONLY)

Location: Bengaluru / India

Employment Type: Full\-time

Experience: 3\-5 years Max

Education: Master’s degree preferred

Industry: Women’s Wellness / Consumer Wellness / FMCG / D2C

ABOUT MOONBLISS

Moonbliss is a women\-centric wellness brand focused on creating thoughtful and effective products for period\-related discomfort and everyday menstrual wellness.

We believe women’s wellness is not limited to solving a single problem. It is about understanding women’s everyday experiences, identifying unmet needs, and building products and solutions that genuinely make their lives better.

We are building Moonbliss from the ground up — from understanding consumers and identifying opportunities to product development, brand building, marketing, distribution, customer experience, and business growth.

We are looking for a leader who can turn this vision into a meaningful and scalable consumer business.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a CEO who can build and lead Moonbliss from the ground up.

This is a highly hands\-on leadership role with ownership across the business. The CEO will work closely with the founders to define the direction of Moonbliss, understand consumers, identify opportunities, develop products, build the brand, create growth strategies, build the right team, and establish the systems required to scale.

We are looking for someone who can think strategically and execute practically.

The ideal candidate should be able to identify an opportunity, understand the underlying problem, develop a plan, bring people together, execute, measure outcomes, and continuously improve.

This role is suited for someone who enjoys building rather than simply managing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1\. VISION, STRATEGY \& BUSINESS BUILDING

* Define and drive the overall vision, strategy, and direction of Moonbliss.
* Identify opportunities within women’s wellness, consumer wellness, FMCG, and adjacent categories.
* Understand market trends, consumer behaviour, emerging categories, and competitive landscapes.
* Develop short\-term and long\-term business plans.
* Define business priorities, goals, KPIs, and growth milestones.
* Evaluate what Moonbliss should build, launch, improve, scale, or discontinue.
* Translate the company’s vision into clear priorities and actionable plans.
* Take ownership of turning opportunities into viable business initiatives.

2\. WOMEN\-CENTRIC CONSUMER UNDERSTANDING

A genuine women\-first perspective is essential for this role.

* Develop a deep understanding of women as consumers and their everyday wellness needs.
* Understand consumer experiences, pain points, behaviours, preferences, and expectations across different life stages.
* Conduct and encourage customer research and continuous feedback collection.
* Identify underserved and overlooked problems within women’s wellness.
* Translate consumer insights into products, services, content, and experiences.
* Ensure customer understanding is at the centre of product, brand, marketing, and business decisions.
* Build a culture where the team consistently asks: “Does this genuinely solve a problem for women?”
* Ensure Moonbliss communicates with women thoughtfully, respectfully, and authentically.

We are not looking for someone who simply sees women as a target audience. We are looking for someone who can build the business with a genuine women\-first perspective.

3\. PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT \& INNOVATION

* Identify and evaluate new product and category opportunities.
* Lead product ideation, validation, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Work closely with product teams, manufacturers, suppliers, consultants, and external partners.
* Evaluate product\-market fit and customer demand.
* Ensure products meet Moonbliss’s quality, positioning, pricing, and consumer expectations.
* Develop a pipeline of future products and business opportunities.
* Balance consumer needs with commercial viability.

4\. BRAND BUILDING

* Own Moonbliss’s overall brand vision, positioning, and direction.
* Build a differentiated, trusted, and relevant women’s wellness brand.
* Work closely with creative, marketing, content, and social media teams.
* Develop brand communication and campaign strategies.
* Ensure consistency across all customer touchpoints.
* Identify opportunities for partnerships, creators, communities, collaborations, and other brand\-building initiatives.
* Build long\-term brand equity while maintaining commercial focus.

5\. GROWTH \& MARKETING

* Develop and execute the overall growth strategy.
* Identify customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and repeat\-purchase opportunities.
* Work across D2C, marketplaces, retail, partnerships, and other relevant channels.
* Develop and evaluate marketing campaigns and growth initiatives.
* Monitor customer acquisition costs, conversion, retention, repeat purchases, and customer lifetime value.
* Analyse marketing and business performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Test new channels, campaigns, partnerships, and growth approaches.
* Combine customer insights with data to make informed growth decisions.

6\. DISTRIBUTION \& BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

* Build and execute Moonbliss’s distribution strategy.
* Identify relevant D2C, marketplace, retail, institutional, partnership, and other channels.
* Build relationships with strategic partners and external stakeholders.
* Identify and evaluate new business opportunities.
* Develop commercial partnerships and collaborations.
* Build scalable distribution systems as the business grows.
* Negotiate and manage key external relationships where required.

7\. FINANCIAL \& COMMERCIAL OWNERSHIP

* Take ownership of overall business performance.
* Understand and monitor revenue, gross margins, costs, customer acquisition, inventory, working capital, and cash flow.
* Work with the finance team on budgets, forecasts, and business plans.
* Establish and monitor key financial and commercial metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and resource allocation.
* Make informed decisions regarding investments, hiring, products, channels, and growth initiatives.
* Maintain a strong balance between growth and commercial discipline.

8\. TEAM BUILDING \& LEADERSHIP

* Build the team required to take Moonbliss to the next stage.
* Hire strong talent across product, marketing, sales, operations, finance, and other functions.
* Define responsibilities, goals, expectations, and performance standards.
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability, creativity, and execution.
* Mentor and develop team members.
* Build leadership capability within the organisation.
* Establish systems and processes that allow the company to scale effectively.

9\. OPERATIONS \& EXECUTION

* Ensure important business initiatives move from ideas to execution.
* Establish processes, systems, and workflows as the business develops.
* Coordinate across product, marketing, operations, finance, sales, and external partners.
* Identify bottlenecks and solve problems quickly.
* Ensure projects remain aligned with business priorities, timelines, and outcomes.
* Create a culture where decisions lead to action and measurable results.

10\. FOUNDER \& STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

* Work directly with the founders on Moonbliss’s strategic direction.
* Present business plans, opportunities, challenges, and performance updates.
* Bring independent perspectives, recommendations, and insights.
* Challenge assumptions when required using data, consumer understanding, and business logic.
* Take ownership of execution following strategic decisions.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, partners, vendors, and external organisations.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

EXPERIENCE — MANDATORY

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience is mandatory.
* Experience in consumer businesses, FMCG, D2C, wellness, beauty, healthcare consumer products, lifestyle brands, or related industries is preferred.
* Experience building, managing, or scaling a business, brand, product, or significant business function is preferred.
* Prior startup, entrepreneurial, or business leadership experience will be an advantage.
* Experience working in an early\-stage or high\-growth environment is valuable.

WOMEN\-CENTRIC MINDSET — ESSENTIAL

* Genuine interest in women’s wellness and consumer needs.
* Strong ability to understand women as consumers.
* Ability to approach business and product decisions from a women\-first consumer perspective.
* Sensitivity and thoughtfulness when working on women’s wellness products and communication.
* Curiosity to understand consumer problems rather than making assumptions.
* Ability to translate consumer insights into meaningful business opportunities.

BUSINESS \& LEADERSHIP

* Strong business and commercial understanding.
* Strategic thinking combined with strong execution ability.
* Ability to identify opportunities and turn them into actionable plans.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving skills.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Entrepreneurial mindset.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Comfortable building teams, systems, and processes from scratch.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Strong analytical and business judgement.

COMMUNICATION — MANDATORY

Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.

The candidate should be comfortable with:

* Communicating with founders and senior stakeholders.
* Presenting business strategies, ideas, and plans.
* Leading meetings and business discussions.
* Negotiating with partners, vendors, and external stakeholders.
* Writing professional emails, reports, presentations, and business documents.
* Communicating clearly with internal and external teams.

EDUCATION

* Master’s degree preferred.
* MBA, Business Management, Marketing, Strategy, Entrepreneurship, or a related field will be an added advantage.
* Relevant professional experience and demonstrated business leadership will also be considered.

WHAT KIND OF PERSON ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for someone who:

* Thinks like an entrepreneur.
* Understands consumers deeply.
* Has a genuine interest in women’s wellness.
* Can identify opportunities others may overlook.
* Is comfortable building from zero.
* Can move seamlessly between strategy and execution.
* Makes decisions and takes ownership of outcomes.
* Can build, manage, and inspire teams.
* Is commercially minded and comfortable with numbers.
* Is curious, analytical, creative, and action\-oriented.
* Can operate effectively when processes and answers are not already defined.
* Enjoys solving problems and turning ideas into action.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a role where you simply manage an existing business and delegate responsibilities.

Moonbliss is being built from the ground up.

We need someone who is willing to get involved — from understanding the customer and evaluating a product idea to reviewing marketing campaigns, discussing distribution, analysing numbers, solving operational problems, and building the team.

We are looking for a business builder, not just a business manager.

WHY JOIN MOONBLISS?

This is an opportunity to take leadership of an early\-stage, women\-centric consumer brand and help shape it from the beginning.

You will have the opportunity to influence:

Consumer → Product → Brand → Marketing → Distribution → Team → Business → Growth

You won’t simply be joining an established company.

You will be helping build one.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Job Description:
**Roles and Responsibilities.**

  

**About Rakuten**


Rakuten is the largest ecommerce company in Japan, and third largest ecommerce marketplace company worldwide. Rakuten has 70\+ business spanning e\-commerce, banking, travel, securities, credit card, e\-money, portal, media, marketing, professional sports and more. The company is expanding globally and currently has operations in Asia, Western Europe, and the Americas.

  

Founded in 1997 Rakuten is headquartered in Tokyo, with over 10,000 employees and partner staff worldwide. Rakuten's 2017 revenues were 944\.47 billions yen.

  

Rakuten India, based in the Silicon valley of India, Bengaluru, provides software development, product development and operations support to Rakuten groups around the globe. With more than 200 highly skilled employees, Rakuten India is helping make Rakuten Ecosystem stronger and better by contributing to technology solutions \& operations; increasing speed, productivity, and quality. Rakuten India's services to Rakuten spans across ecommerce, digital contents and marketing, FinTech, Leisure \& Emerging Technology, and Corporate IT division.

  

**Job Description**


Function:


IT Operations and Support


IT Management / IT Support/IT Infrastructure / ITIL 4 foundation certified/ Cloud knowledge

  

Working in the area of information technology, an incident manager is essentially responsible for the upkeep and smooth operations of IT systems, identifying, managing, and resolving time\-sensitive escalations, and performing analysis of data from a variety of sources to identify possible risk indicators. They oversee all aspects of the incident coordination process, from evaluation to resolution. An Incident Coordinator records all issues and helps to design ways to prevent similar problems in the future. He or she will coordinate between technical support teams, create procedures to deal with problems, and develop or figure out solutions.

  

Responsibilities:


* Identifying, managing, and resolving time\-sensitive escalations in a 24X7 setup.
* Acting as PIC for customers during an incident/outage, provide regular status updates and handle escalations.
* Performing analysis of data from a variety of sources to identify possible risk indicators.
* Performing incident triage, to include determining scope, urgency, and potential impact; identifying the specific vulnerability; and making recommendations that enable expeditious remediation.
* Performing escalation trend analysis and reporting.
* Performing real\-time incident handling tasks to support worldwide operations.
* Analyzing escalations from various sources within Rakuten, determining possible root causes, and identifying preventative actions.
* Tracking and documenting incidents from initial detection through final resolution.
* Writing and publishing techniques, guidance, and reports on incident findings.
* Coordinating with analysts to correlate risk assessment data.
* Monitoring external data sources to maintain currency of threat condition and determine which issues may have an impact on production operations.
* Drafting and presenting deep\-dive documents and reports on policy and process gaps to senior executives.
  

Ideal Candidate for this Role:


* Should be able to manage the incidents single \-handedly.
* Understand the implications of change(s) and flag risks as required.
* Consider the relative costs, benefits, and impact of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.
* Lead the post\-incident investigation process, drive future corrective actions, and monitor exceptions.
* Dissect complex problems to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.
* Function effectively in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
  

Requirements:


* Minimum 6\+ years of experience managing incidents, escalations, crisis management, risk management, or other relevant experience in a fast\-paced environment.
* Can handle the pressure of working in a 24x7 incident management setup.
* Deep knowledge of infrastructure setup and data center operations.
* Familiarity with multiple monitoring and analytic tools, databases, and techniques.
* Exceptional bias for action willing to move quickly and decisively to resolve an incident.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* ITIL certified and possesses sound knowledge of problem and incident management.
  

Preferred Qualification:


* 2\-3 years of experience working in industries which support public/private cloud, data center operations, NOC, SOC, etc.
* 2\+ years working cross\-functionally with tech and non\-tech teams.
* Working knowledge of cloud platform and experience in AWS/GCP/Azure is a must.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated experience writing for and briefing executive\-level stakeholders.
* Ability to think critically and logically, with the vision to work both tactically and strategically.
  

**Why Explore a Career at Rakuten**

  

So we challenge ourselves to evolve, innovate and experiment, to create a better, happier future for everyone.

  

Today, our 70\+ businesses span e\-commerce, digital content, communications and fintech, bringing the joy of discovery to more than 1 billion members across the world. We think big. with the passion of a start\-up and the influence of a global leader, we're finding extraordinary new ways to disrupt markets and dazzle customers.

### **Description and Requirements**

**Role Overview**


The **Senior Specialist – Consumer Make in India \& Category Management** will primarily be responsible for driving Lenovo India's **Consumer Make in India (MII) strategy and execution**, while also managing key category, alliance, and consumer\-insights responsibilities.


The role will work closely with **Lenovo AP teams, manufacturing partners, supply chain, product teams, finance, strategic technology partners, and global stakeholders** to identify and execute opportunities for local manufacturing, ensure supply readiness, and support the growth and profitability of the Consumer business.


In addition, the role will own the **Consumer Chromebook category**, manage strategic technology alliances, and provide actionable consumer and market insights to support business decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Make in India – Primary Responsibility**

* Own and manage the **end\-to\-end Consumer Make in India process**, from product identification and feasibility assessment through manufacturing readiness and execution.
* Assess the Consumer product portfolio and identify **products/categories suitable for local manufacturing in India**.
* Evaluate business, operational, supply\-chain and commercial considerations for bringing products into local manufacturing.

title: Global Digital Asset Services Coordinator
description:
3M has a long\-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.**Job Description:**

**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**


Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

 **The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**


The Global Digital Asset Operations Coordinator has a significant impact by ensuring 3M’s digital assets are managed consistently, efficiently, and in alignment with global business standards. By coordinating projects, connecting stakeholders across regions and functions, and supporting governance practices, this role helps improve asset quality, metadata accuracy, publishing readiness, and operational visibility. This enables faster content delivery, better reuse of approved assets, reduced duplication of work, stronger compliance with digital asset standards, and improved collaboration among marketing, product, creative, IT, and business teams. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Manage and coordinate global digital asset projects from intake through completion, including request workflows, timelines, dependencies, image planning meetings, stakeholder coordination, and alignment with the Global Digital Asset Services Supervisor and GMSS PCO priorities. Ensure timely, high\-quality delivery by prioritizing concurrent requests, tracking milestones, resolving risks or delivery issues, escalating concerns when needed, and supporting downstream requirements such as channel syndication.
* Enable stakeholder engagement and cross\-functional collaboration by serving as a key coordination point between Digital Asset Services, Business Groups, Product Content teams, Digital Compliance, IT, studio operations, photographers, and other partners to address asset needs, resolve issues, support improvements, and align service requirements.
* Translate business needs into actionable digital asset work by converting stakeholder requirements into clear work items, including user stories, business requirements, acceptance criteria, IT backlog inputs, sprint planning support, and enhancement priorities for DAM systems and workflows.
* Support governance, standards, and asset lifecycle management by reinforcing global DAM processes, metadata standards, taxonomy practices, product photography standards, documentation, audits, archival support, data quality checks, and ongoing repository maintenance in alignment with the Global Digital Asset Services Supervisor.
* Track and analyze operational metrics, stakeholder feedback, and workflow data using Workfront, Power BI, and Excel to support service performance reporting, informed decision\-making, workload visibility, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)\-based digital asset management and production workflows by ensuring assets are complete, compliant, searchable, correctly linked to PIM systems, and aligned with Workfront workflows for efficient storage, publishing, and downstream use. Coordinate global photography and digital asset production activities by managing requests, product movement, shoot status, quality reviews, and timely delivery of publication\-ready assets.

 **Your Skills and Expertise**

**To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher required, with 4–7 years of overall experience and hands\-on expertise in Digital Asset Management systems, preferably Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) or similar platforms.
* Strong project management skills with experience leading and supporting digital asset, digitization, and operational projects from intake through completion, ensuring timely and quality delivery while applying Lean methodologies and process optimization practices to improve efficiency, workflows, and overall service performance.
* Ability to coordinate cross\-functional initiatives across global and regional business teams, aligning with leadership, stakeholders, vendors, studio partners, photographers, and service providers.
* Proven experience managing workflows and deliverables, including request intake, timelines, dependencies, milestones, stakeholder expectations, channel syndication, and downstream digital asset distribution processes.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, reporting, data validation, and managing large datasets for business decisions and KPI tracking.
* Excellent change management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to adapt quickly, pivot as priorities shift, respond effectively to changes in business needs, systems, workflows, or processes, and support teams through new system implementations while maintaining operational continuity and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong digital asset management and operational coordination experience, including managing digital asset workflows, projects, and programs across cross\-functional teams, with experience in metadata governance, digital standards, asset lifecycle management, quality control, reporting tools, and Workfront requests, projects, templates, or programs.
* undefined.

 **Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:**

* Creative, DAM, and PIM system experience: Experience with Adobe Photoshop, including typesetting, masking, clipping paths, layers, groups, color theory, and layout, along with knowledge of P360 or similar PIM systems and DAM\-PIM interoperability.
* Photography, syndication, and marketing technology support: Experience coordinating commercial photography workflows, supporting photography studio operations, channel syndication, eCommerce, SEO, analytics, or marketing technology initiatives.
* Program leadership and process improvement: Proven ability to support large applications, global programs, and process improvement initiatives, with knowledge of change management, GMSS best practices, 3M business structure, and the ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.

description:
**Job Description:**


Data Engineer (Manager and/or Senior) \- Job Description (L30\)


As the **“Data Engineer (Manager and/or Senior)”**, reporting to the **“Senior Director Data Engineer”**, you will own the end\-to\-end data supply chain that powers analytics and AI for our global clients. You will onboard multi\-source data through Adverity into the Data Refinery layer, manage data transformations in Trifacta, and land governed, quality\-checked datasets in Databricks, using Unity Catalog for governance and lineage, SQL and PySpark for further transformation, and automated data quality health checks to embed trust at every stage. You will apply dbt and GitHub for orchestration, version control, and repeatable, well\-governed delivery. Working closely with Analytics, Media, Product, and Engineering teams, you will turn fragmented, reactive data processes into a proactive, well\-documented, AI\-ready foundation built on a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture.


You are ideally based in the Greater Detroit, MI area, but we are considering candidates within the continental United States as well.

**Responsibilities**

* Onboard and normalize multi\-source data through Adverity, standing up and maintaining Data Refinery pipelines that connect marketing, media, and platform sources into a single, reliable ingestion layer.
* Ingest, model, and reconcile DSP data (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk, Amazon DSP) against CM360 ad\-server delivery, applying programmatic media expertise to distinguish buy\-side activation and bidding from independent ad serving/counting, and to resolve impression, spend, and attribution discrepancies between platforms.
* Manage and maintain data transformations in Trifacta, building governed, repeatable wrangling recipes that cleanse, standardize, and shape raw inputs into analytics\-ready structures.
* Govern data assets in Databricks Unity Catalog, managing catalogs, schemas, permissions, lineage, and metadata to keep data secure, consistent, and discoverable across the platform.
* Develop and optimize further transformations in Databricks using SQL, PySpark, notebooks, and workflows, extending refined data through the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture into curated, consumption\-ready models.
* Design, run, and monitor data quality health checks in Databricks, including row\-level integrity, schema and version validation, reconciliation logic, and automated error logging, to embed trust and observability at every stage of the pipeline.
* Working understanding and familiarity to apply modular, tested, and documented transformation orchestration, and GitHub for version control, CI/CD, code review, and change governance across SQL, Python, and YAML assets.
* Design modular, reusable, and well\-documented data models that support analytics, reporting, and AI enablement, with clear definitions, lineage, and business context.
* Collaborate with analysts, engineers, and business leads to translate raw, multi\-source data into governed, insight\-ready datasets that support performance reporting and downstream decisioning.
* Contribute to data quality standards, monitoring, and the platform roadmap, defining best practices for reusable components, transformation patterns, and observability that scale across teams and clients.
* Prepare certified, well\-modeled datasets for the consumption layer and reporting tools such as Power BI, ensuring metrics are consistent, governed, and traceable to source.


Qualifications

* 4\-6\+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role building and operating scalable, production data pipelines.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required; Graduate degree preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with Adverity for data onboarding and normalization, including building and maintaining Data Refinery ingestion pipelines across multiple marketing and media sources.
* Proven experience managing data transformations in Trifacta (Alteryx Designer Cloud), including building governed, repeatable wrangling recipes for cleansing and standardization.
* Advanced expertise with Databricks, including Unity Catalog governance (catalogs, permissions, lineage, metadata), transformation development in SQL and PySpark, and Databricks Workflows, Notebooks, and Jobs.
* Demonstrated experience designing and operating data quality health checks, including integrity tests, reconciliation logic, schema validation, and automated monitoring, within a Databricks environment.
* Familiarity with dbt (dbt Labs) for transformation orchestration and testing, and with GitHub for version control, CI/CD, and code governance in a collaborative development workflow.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data engineering, transformation, and automation.
* Working knowledge of medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture, data modeling, lineage, and governance best practices for analytics\-ready data.
* Self\-starter with the ability to learn new tools quickly and deliver scalable, well\-documented solutions across the data stack, driving continuous improvement and measurable impact.
* Bonus: Experience in advertising, marketing, or digital media environments, particularly performance reporting, reconciliation automation, or data quality optimization.

title: Test Manager
description:
**Change the world. Love your job.**
  

Are you looking to grow your career in production testing at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world? At Texas Instruments (TI) a Production Test Engineer ensures manufactured components and assembled products meet company standards and objectives. You'll develop and implement testing and evaluation methods and create test plans based on production specifications and requirements. You'll use your talent to perform testing and compiling and analyzing data for review and identification of manufacturing and production issues.


**Who are we and what do we do?**
The advanced circuits and power solution business is known for delivering industry leading custom IC system solutions including display and touch power products, charger power products, camera PMICs, power path devices, sensing devices and high\-performance communication interface products. Our products integrate precision signal\-chain and highly efficient power components in ultra\-small form factors that enable TI’s best\-in\-class customer to translate their ideas to high value products that revolutionize the personal electronics market.
  

  

In this team, you will get to work with, and learn from incredibly talented technical leaders, who have influenced TI technology, productivity and way of working in a creative and impactful way. You will get to directly interact with one of TI’s valued and high\-volume customers, by way of intense technical reviews and architecture discussions!
  

  

By enabling designs that are highly impactful to TI revenue and working with a critical customer on a versatile set of products, you will find yourself on an accelerated career path.  

  

  

  

**Responsibilities include:**


* Utilize analog circuit analysis and Automated Test Equipment debug knowledge to troubleshoot test, quality, and device performance issues
* Develop test processes, fixtures and software for automated test equipment for optimized production use
* Establish and influence next\-generation test solutions that help achieve the lowest obtainable costs on future products
* Facilitate and support new multi\-factory manufacturing test and assembly flows
* Analyze test solution robustness through correlated performance and sameness verification techniques
* Perform yield analysis and work with fabs for yield improvements where applicable
* Lead Silicon Test \& Validation development activities with product ownership and responsibility from definition to release to manufacturing.
* Direct, guide and participate in activities of a research or technical function responsible for silicon char, production testing, qualification, developing, modifying and evaluating electronic parts, components, integrated circuits for a variety of applications.
* Make assignments for team members, providing technical guidance as needed, developing schedules and monitoring progress throughout the project.
* Evaluate intermediate and final results of projects during the development phase and during silicon evaluation, to ensure accomplishment of technical objectives.
**Qualifications**
------------------


**Minimum requirements:**


* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, electrical \& computer engineering, mathematics, physics or a related field of study
* XX years' work related experience
* Experience with USP and Testware, Eagle 364/500, LTX Fusion, Catalyst, Agilent 407x, Ultraflex
* ATE expertise
* Probe card hardware and circuit design experience
* Software development experience
  

  

**Preferred qualifications:**


* Experience with ATE plaforms including:ETS364, ETS500, LTX Fusion HFI, LTX Fusion HT, Teradyne Catalyst, Teradyne UltraFlex, Agilent 4062 and 4071
* Experience with Agilent customer framework features and scripting
* Knowledge of Mbayse analysis for both TP and MP
* Knowledge of EDGE probe release system and probe build documentation
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem solving skills
* Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results
* Strong time management skills that enable on\-time project delivery
* Ability to work effectively in an interrupt\-driven, fast\-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
* Problem solving skills, including meticulous attention to details
* Ability to communicate effectively across functional boundaries and with upper management
* Ability to work in stressful situations and arrive at creative and effective solutions
* Ability to think strategically

**Organizational Skills:** Ability to work well with internal cross functional teams. Must successfully and appropriately interface with external customers. Project management, time management, multi\-tasking, problem solving and communication (written and oral) are important skills in this role. Must be able to manage assigned tasks with minimal supervision.
  

  

**Team and People Skills:** Candidate must be team oriented and must be able to work with TI\-internal and external groups (systems, test, sales, marketing, customers, etc.) to resolve issues and generate business success. The ability to work well with others and to perform in a team environment is essential.  

  

  



**About Us**
------------


**Why TI?**
* Engineer your future. We empower our employees to truly own their career and development. Come collaborate with some of the smartest people in the world to shape the future of electronics.
* We're different by design. Diverse backgrounds and perspectives are what push innovation forward and what make TI stronger. We value each and every voice, and look forward to hearing yours. Meet the people of TI
* Benefits that benefit you. We offer competitive pay and benefits designed to help you and your family live your best life. Your well\-being is important to us. Please find our country\-specific benefits here

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. title: Retention Manager - Product Growth
description:
**Retention Manager – Product Growth**
======================================


**Location:** Bangalore (Office – HSR Layout)


**Department:** CRM / Growth


**Experience:** 5\-8 years  

  

  



**About AppsForBharat**


AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir App) is building beautifully crafted, AI\-first consumer experiences that help millions of Indians connect with spirituality and culture. We’re backed by Peak XV Partners, Elevation, Fundamentum, and other top\-tier investors, and are one of India’s fastest\-growing Series C consumer\-tech companies.


Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, is the world’s largest platform for Hindu devotees, powering rituals, teachings, personalized recommendations, and a thriving devotional community. India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.


### **About the Role**


We’re looking for a Retention Manager – Product Growth to own one of our most important growth problems: how do we get users to come back, transact more frequently, and build a long\-term relationship with Sri Mandir?


This role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, CRM and Data. You will use user behaviour, cohort insights and experimentation to identify retention opportunities and turn them into scalable product, engagement and lifecycle interventions.


This is not a traditional CRM/campaign role. You will own the retention problem, while working with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to determine the right levers to solve it.


### **What You Will Own**


* **Retention Strategy:** Build and drive the retention roadmap across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value user cohorts.
* **User \& Behaviour Insights:** Deep\-dive into user behaviour, cohorts, frequency, repeat patterns and LTV to identify the biggest retention opportunities.
* **Product\-led Retention:** Design and scale interventions such as subscriptions, loyalty/reward systems, personalisation, pricing/discounting and repeat\-use experiences.
* **Experimentation:** Build a continuous experimentation pipeline — identify hypotheses, define success metrics, launch experiments and measure incremental impact.
* **Reactivation \& Frequency:** Identify opportunities to bring dormant users back and increase the frequency of existing users through product and engagement interventions.
* **Cross\-functional Execution:** Partner closely with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to take retention initiatives from insight PRD/experiment launch measurement scale.
* **Retention Measurement:** Build frameworks to understand the impact of retention initiatives on repeat rate, frequency, revenue, contribution margin and LTV.

### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **1\. Diagnose Retention Problems**


* Analyse retention and repeat behaviour across user, category, product, deity, geography, platform, acquisition source and other relevant dimensions.
* Identify where and why users drop off across their lifecycle.
* Translate data into clear behavioural insights and actionable opportunities.

#### **2\. Build Retention Solutions**


* Convert insights into product, loyalty, personalisation and lifecycle hypotheses.
* Work with Product and CRM teams to design solutions that address specific user needs and behavioural gaps.
* Prioritise opportunities based on expected user and business impact.

#### **3\. Run a Strong Experimentation Engine**


* Own the retention experimentation roadmap.
* Define hypotheses, control/treatment groups, success metrics and measurement frameworks.
* Evaluate experiments based on **incremental impact**, not just engagement metrics.
* Scale successful interventions and quickly learn from unsuccessful ones.

#### **4\. Improve Repeat \& Lifetime Value**


* Develop strategies to increase repeat transactions and user frequency.
* Identify opportunities to move users from first transaction repeat high\-frequency behaviour.
* Build interventions that improve long\-term user value rather than short\-term conversion alone.

#### **5\. Build Retention Intelligence**


* Develop and maintain retention dashboards and reporting frameworks for daily/weekly decision\-making.
* Track key metrics including retention, repeat rate, frequency, reactivation and LTV.
* Establish clear measurement frameworks for major retention initiatives.

### **What We’re Looking For**


* **6–8 years of experience** in growth, retention, product growth, lifecycle, consumer internet or related roles.
* Strong experience solving **consumer retention and engagement problems** through data and experimentation.
* Strong analytical ability with hands\-on experience in **cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention metrics and LTV/business impact analysis**.
* Strong product sense — able to identify user problems and translate them into product or growth opportunities.
* Experience running **A/B tests and growth experiments** end\-to\-end.
* Understanding of CRM/lifecycle marketing and how communication can complement product\-led retention.
* Comfortable working with **SQL, product analytics and dashboards** such as Mixpanel, Metabase, Superset or equivalent tools.
* Strong cross\-functional skills — able to work effectively with Product, Data, Design, CRM and Business teams.
* Bias towards action, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and independently identify and solve high\-impact problems.

### **What Will Make You Successful**


You should naturally think in a loop:


**Understand user behaviour Identify the retention problem Form a hypothesis Build the right intervention Experiment Measure incremental impact Scale**


You should be equally comfortable discussing:


* Why a user did not return
* What behavioural segment is most valuable
* What product change could improve repeat behaviour
* Whether a subscription/loyalty intervention will actually create incremental retention
* How CRM can amplify a product intervention
* Whether an experiment genuinely moved LTV or simply shifted existing demand

### **Key Deliverables**


* **Retention Opportunity Roadmap** across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value cohorts
* **Retention \& Cohort Intelligence Dashboard** for ongoing decision\-making
* Continuous **Retention Experimentation Pipeline** with clear hypotheses and measurement
* Successful rollout and optimisation of **product\-led retention initiatives**
* Measurable improvement in **repeat rate, retention, frequency, reactivation and LTV**
* Clear post\-launch measurement and learning framework for all major retention initiatives

### **Why This Role Matters**


Sri Mandir serves users across very different spiritual needs, behaviours and frequencies. The next phase of growth is not only about acquiring more users — it is about **understanding what brings users back and building experiences that make the next spiritual action easier, more relevant and more meaningful.**


This role will be at the centre of that problem — **building the systems, insights and experiments that turn one\-time users into long\-term users.**


**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys**

title: Technical Marketing Engineering Leader (10-17 years| Bangalore)
description:
What We Do
  
  

Isovalent, now part of Cisco, is the company founded by the creators of Cilium and eBPF. We build open\-source software and enterprise solutions addressing networking, security, and observability needs for modern cloud\-native infrastructure. Powered by flagship technologies, Cilium and Tetragon, our Isovalent Enterprise Platform is chosen by industry\-leading global organizations for its innovative capabilities.
  
  

Meet the Team
  
  

Join the Isovalent Technical MindshareTeam, where we are passionate about creating exceptional content about cloud native networking and security. We write blog posts, speak at conferences, create hands\-on labs, prepare reusable demos, make case studies, run workshops, record videos, tackle reference architectures, and sometimes even find the time to author books and white papers. As part of a growing team at the forefront of innovation, you'll work with groundbreaking technologies like Cilium and Tetragon and play a pivotal role in introducing the technology to users, prospects, and customers. With our acquisition by Cisco, this is an exciting time to join a team that values creativity, collaboration, and innovation.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

In this role, you’ll be instrumental in driving Isovalent’s content strategy and execution in the public cloud space, ensuring we create engaging content around public cloud challenges and solutions that sparks curiosity in prospects, customers, partners, and topic related communities alike.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
  

Use your domain knowledge and technical expertise and build engaging technical content that helps our sales teams, partners, customers, and the community to learn the value and benefits of our cloud native solutions in the context of public cloud challenges.
  
Create blog posts, practical guides, product demos, case studies, white papers, presentations, video, etc. advocating and educating network engineers, DevOps, SecOps, SREs, and Kubernetes platform ops.
  
Research new use cases and create technical content for them in collaboration with product management, product marketing and engineering.
  
Run webinars and workshops and take part in topic related conferences in close cooperation with the field and events teams.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

**As a key part of our content team, you:**  

* Overall 10\+ Years of industry experience
* Will either have 5\+ years of experience intechnical writing, technical marketing OR 5\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing role likesales engineer or solution architect.
* Are able to adapt product storytelling into compelling write\-ups and demos.
* Have previously worked in a technical marketing function on topics related to Cilium, Tetragon, and eBPF.
* Have good knowledge ofLinux and Kubernetes.
* Have deep understanding and familiarity of public cloud technologies (EKS, AKS, etc).


Preferred Experience
  
  

* Experience participating in Open Source projects.
* Experience with operating Kubernetes.
* Experience in network engineering.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel up to 20% and manage remote work effectively.
* Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* Cisco networking knowledge is a bonus.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  

Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

description:

Leica Microsystems is proud to work alongside a community of nine fellow Danaher Life Sciences companies. Together, we’re pioneering the future of science and medicine, developing products that enable researchers in the fight to save lives.


Job Title: Associate Marketing Manager

**Purpose of the position:**

  

The Associate Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning and executing strategic Field Marketing initiatives to drive business growth, customer engagement, brand awareness, and demand generation for Leica Microsystems in India. This is an onsite role based in Bangalore.


A key focus of this position will be developing and managing relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare practitioners, leading hospitals, academic institutes, and clinical stakeholders, particularly in specialties such as Neurosurgery, ENT, Plastic \& reconstructive, Ophthalmology, and related disciplines. Also work closely with the Principal Scientists, Researchers and Investigators in Life Sciences to drive engagement. The incumbent will lead the execution of Continuing Medical Education (CME) programs, clinical workshops, hands\-on training sessions, scientific meetings, symposia, congresses, and product demonstration programs to promote scientific engagement and adoption of Leica Microsystems solutions.


In addition, the role will support digital marketing initiatives, lead generation activities, customer engagement programs, and marketing campaigns in close collaboration with Sales, Service, Customer Care, and Global Marketing teams. The position reports to the Marketing Head/Manager, India.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain relationships with KOLs, neurosurgeons, healthcare practitioners, hospitals, and medical societies.
* Develop and execute KOL engagement plans by building and maintaining the annual KOL pipeline to drive clinical advocacy, scientific collaboration, and product adoption.
* Coordinate KOL participation in CMEs, workshops, congresses, webinars, speaker programs, and advisory boards.
* Support development of clinical testimonials, case studies, and customer success stories.
* Plan and execute CME programs, surgical workshops, hands\-on training sessions, scientific meetings, and conferences.
* Partner with healthcare professionals, scientists and researchers from institutions across India to deliver impactful educational programs.
* Manage end\-to\-end program execution including faculty coordination, logistics, budgets, and post\-event evaluation.
* Execute field marketing initiatives aligned with business objectives across all the divisions for Medical and Life Sciences.
* Drive demand generation through congresses, exhibitions, product launches, webinars, workshops, and customer engagement events.
* Manage event planning, vendors, agencies, logistics, budgets, and ROI tracking.
* Execute and optimize digital campaigns across LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, and other platforms.
* Integrate digital and field marketing activities to generate and nurture leads.
* Monitor campaign performance and provide insights to improve marketing effectiveness.

**Our Expectations**

* Candidate should have 4\-5 years of sales experience in the healthcare, medical device, life sciences, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical sectors, along with 8\-10 years of marketing experience, preferably in medical devices, implants, or healthcare capital equipment.
* Strong background in KOL engagement, physician relationship management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Experience working with healthcare practitioners, preferably Neurosurgeons, ophthalmologists or other surgical fraternity.
* Proven ability to organize CMEs, workshops, training programs, scientific meetings, and conferences.
* Excellent communication, networking, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Marketing, Science, or related field; MBA preferred.
* Hands\-on experience in KOL management, physician engagement, CME planning, workshops, and scientific events.


Leica Microsystems, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

Competitive intelligence is core to how we position Glean as an AI leader and how we differentiate our platform. The role sits in Bangalore and will be a key driver of competitive intelligence, owning the upkeep of our market landscape and competitive positioning, and delivering rapid, high\-impact insights to the field.

* Track key market development and launches, and maintain a view of competitive landscape

Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru\-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.
  

  

Today, 20 million\+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.
  

  

We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way.
  

  

Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million\+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
  

  

And this is just the beginning!
  

  

**What’s the role?**
  

  

Jar's gold savings business is the core of the company. It serves first\-time digital savers, largely outside the metros, and it moves real money every day. We are looking for a Growth Lead to own it end to end.
  

  

This is a P\&L\-shaped role rather than a channel\-shaped one. You will own gold GMV and every input that produces it: activating new savers, increasing the frequency and ticket size of existing ones, retaining them, winning back the ones who have gone quiet, and expanding them into adjacent products. The measure of success is a durable change in the slope of the business, not a good quarter.
  

  

The distinction that matters most to us is how you get there. We are looking for someone who drives growth primarily through product, and uses campaigns, lifecycle and comms to amplify what the product has already earned. Teams that lean on discounting and notification volume can hold a number for a quarter. They cannot compound. You will have a cross\-functional pod of product managers, growth managers, analysts and lifecycle owners to do this properly, and you will own the roadmap that directs them.
  

  

You will report to the VP of Growth who currently holds this scope alongside Jar's jewellery vertical and new business lines. You will be reviewed on the business and its narrative, not on individual projects.

  

  

**What will be your responsibilities?**  

  



*Own the GMV equation*


* Decompose gold GMV into its constituent inputs and maintain a clear point of view on which input is binding in any given quarter.
* Set the roadmap and sequencing across activation, frequency, retention, win\-back and cross\-sell, and defend the trade\-offs between them.
* Carry the number. Report performance and the reasoning behind it directly to leadership.
  


  

*Grow revenue per user*


* Increase transaction frequency and ticket size through changes to the saving experience: habit loops, goals, streaks, visible progress, and the moments that bring a user back unprompted.
* Identify and close leakage across the transactional spine \- accumulation flows, autopay, withdrawals and liquidation, pricing, rewards and refunds.
* Build the cross\-sell and upsell path into Jar's wider surface without cannibalising core saving behaviour.
  


  

*Retain and win back*


* Own retention as a product problem. Diagnose why cohorts decay and fix the reasons, rather than managing the symptom through lifecycle messaging.
* Segment dormant and churned users by cause of departure and build differentiated win\-back paths for each.
  


  

*Drive experimentation*


* Design and run a high\-throughput experiment programme with clear hypotheses, adequate power, and honest read\-outs.
* Make kill decisions quickly and document what was learned. Protect the team from shipping things that tested flat.
  


  

*Lead the pod*


* Manage and grow a cross\-functional team of product managers, growth managers, analysts and lifecycle owners.
* Set the hiring bar for your team and make the selection calls.
* Work closely with engineering, design, data and marketing to get work shipped on pace.
  


  

*Operate the business*


* Maintain the instrumentation and dashboards needed to know the state of the business without being told.
* Respond to breakages in a live money product with appropriate urgency, and close the detection gaps that allowed them to go unnoticed.
  

  

**What’s required from you?**  

  



* 7\+ years in consumer growth, product or monetisation roles, including at least 2 years managing a team or a pod.
* Demonstrable ownership of a revenue or GMV number, with the ability to speak precisely about what you moved and how.
* A track record of product\-led growth. You should be able to walk through a product change you shipped that durably moved a retention or frequency metric, and explain why it worked.
* Strong quantitative foundation. SQL fluency is expected and not delegated. Comfort with cohort analysis, funnel instrumentation and experiment design.
* Experience in consumer fintech, commerce, mobility, or on\-demand at scale in India. Exposure to Tier 2 and Tier 3 users is a significant advantage; instincts built on metro\-affluent products do not transfer cleanly.
* Bachelor's in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline from a reputed institute, or an MBA from a reputed institute.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and limited supervision. This role assumes you will find your own problems.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You will be explaining the business to leadership and to your team on a weekly cadence.
* Working knowledge of analytics and lifecycle tooling (Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, Data Studio or equivalent).
  

  

**What makes us different?**
  

  

We’re not just building a product—we’re shaping the future of savings in India. We seek people who bring passion, energy, and fresh ideas to help us make that happen. Experience matters, but we are a potential first organisation. We move fast, learn from our mistakes, and take bold risks to solve problems that haven’t been attempted before. If you’re excited about working in an environment where people inspire and truly support each other, you’ve found the right fit.
  

  

**What do we stand for?**
  

  

The five values that we live by :
  

  

**Passion:** At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work.
  

**Equality:** We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves.
  

**Growth:** When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact.
  

**Accountability:** The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions.
  

**Consistency:** We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time.
  

  

Join us and let’s build something amazing together!
  

  

**What employee benefits do we have?**
  

  

Glad you asked! Among other things, we have


* Medical Insurance for employees and their families
* ESOPs allocation
* Pluxee meal card
* Swish club card for exclusive employee discounts
* Advance salary plans
* Relocation assistance
* L\&D programmes

title: Events Marketing Manager
description:
**About Juspay**
================



Juspay is a leading multinational payments technology company, powering superior conversion rates, seamless customer experiences, cost optimization, and fraud reduction at scale for 500\+ top global enterprises and banks. Founded in 2012, the company processes over 300 million daily transactions, exceeding an annualized total payment volume (TPV) of $1 trillion with 99\.999% reliability. Headquartered in Bangalore, India, Juspay’s global network of 1200\+ payment experts operates across San Francisco, Dublin, São Paulo, and Singapore.



Juspay offers a modular and interoperable product suite for merchants that includes open\-source payment orchestration, seamless authentication, payment tokenization, fraud \& risk management, global payouts, end\-to\-end reconciliation, unified payment analytics, and more. For banks, Juspay’s offerings include end\-to\-end white label payment gateway solutions \& real\-time payments infrastructure.



\*\*  

About the Role\*\*



Payments is a relationship business, and events are where Juspay earns a seat at the table with the CXOs, product leaders, and engineering teams who decide how the world’s largest merchants and banks move money. We’re looking for an Events Marketing Manager to own that surface end\-to\-end — from flagship industry conferences and proprietary Juspay events to regional roadshows and partner co\-marketing activations.



This is a “day 1” ownership role, not a checklist job. You’ll be trusted to set the events strategy, not just execute a calendar handed to you — deciding which stages Juspay should be on, what story we tell there, and how we prove it moved the pipeline.



\*\*  

What You’ll Do\*\*


* Own the end\-to\-end events calendar and strategy — flagship industry conferences (e.g. Global Fintech Fest, Money20/20, industry payments summits), Juspay\-hosted events, partner/bank co\-marketing activations, and regional roadshows across our key markets.


* Lead planning and execution for each event: budgeting, vendor and venue negotiation, booth/stage design coordination with creative teams, logistics, staffing, and on\-ground run of show.


* Partner with Sales, Product, and Leadership to define event goals, target account lists, speaking topics, and messaging — and to prep spokespeople and booth staff.


* Manage pre\-event demand generation (invites, landing pages, email sequences) and post\-event follow\-up in coordination with the growth/demand\-gen team, ensuring leads are captured, qualified, and routed without leakage.


* Own sponsorship strategy: evaluate inbound and outbound sponsorship opportunities, negotiate packages, and track deliverables against contracts.


* Track and report on event ROI — pipeline sourced/influenced, cost per lead/meeting, and brand impact — and use that data to continuously reprioritize the calendar.


* Coordinate speaking submissions, award nominations, and media/analyst interactions tied to events, working closely with PR and Content Marketing.


* Manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, and production partners; build a playbook that makes each subsequent event faster and cheaper to run.


* Travel to on\-ground events as needed (domestic and international) to run execution personally.


**Must\-Have Qualities**


* 3\+ years of experience in B2B events marketing, field marketing, or experiential marketing


* Comfort negotiating with vendors, venues, and sponsors, and managing a budget with real accountability for ROI.


* Sharp project management instincts — juggling multiple events in flight, with dozens of moving parts and stakeholders, without dropping details.


* Ease of working cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Design, and Leadership; you can pull a room together and keep it aligned under deadline pressure.


* Excellent written and verbal communication,


* Willingness to travel for on\-site execution.
